lines.text: The ark was placed inside David's tent, and he gave every man and woman a loaf, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
David appointed Levites to minister before the ark, with Asaph sounding the cymbals and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blowing trumpets.
David's song says God swore an oath to Abraham and promised the land of Egypt as Israel's inheritance.
God rebuked priests on behalf of the wanderers, saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones!"
David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests at the high place in Gibeon to present burnt offerings morning and evening.
